summary.text: Viola Davis is a Democratic member of the Georgia House of Representatives who has represented District 87 since January 14, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Timothy Burson.

paragraphs.text: Davis was assigned to the Defense and Veterans Affairs, House Health, Insurance, Natural Resources and Environment, and House Urban Affairs committees for 2025-2026.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, receiving 9,012 votes in an uncontested primary.
